author: littledaddychop
body: Hi, I was playing Avicus until I was banned for "ban evading" because apparently the mod Flyo thinks I'm MrNuggly.  If you do not believe me I can skype, facetime, or whatever to prove that I am not MrNuggly, but his brother.

replies.author: JDKL
replies.body:
G'day littledaddychop,
Would you be able to come onto the Avicus Teamspeak (ts.avicus.net), to prove that you're two different people? If you're unable to access TeamSpeak, please add me on Skype (jy31492), so that I can hear both of you speak at the same time.
Kind Regards,
Flyo - Avicus Moderator
